name: Sutanuka Ghosh Roy

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sutanuka Ghosh Roy works across poetry, literary criticism and translation. Her published contributor biographies connect her academic work with Tarakeswar Degree College and identify Opera as her first poetry collection. Her writing also includes a study of Rassundari Dasi’s Amar Jiban and a Bengali translation of Sharan Kumar Limbale’s fiction, bringing creative writing into conversation with critical reading.

Her poems here give ordinary objects a disquieting presence. In “Crossing”, household appliances and flowers seem to speak around a body in pain, until an unseen voice announces a threshold. “Bouquet” places the applause of a book launch beside a hidden notebook and an uneasy private moment. The flowers at its close sharpen the contrast between public celebration and what remains concealed.
